translation.gate_g_batch_3_to_5_note: At the user's request, Gate G reviewed source pp.286-302 in one bounded activity. One definite correction was applied on p.286: the verified Tamil/source-sensitive form `இந்தக் கேமிரா கழுவும்போது` had been interpretively rendered as 'When this camera develops'; it is now retained as the source-odd 'When this camera is washed'. No other definite correction was required in pp.286-302. The review re-confirmed the TIDEL figures and camera/light humour; TamilNet, Unicode and High Court material; `four, just four`; WorldTel and Economic and Political Weekly passages; the source-awkward `stand started`; the printed Polaris letter including `more then 100% per year`; the two-Periyasamy joke; Nanguneri births/deaths and `My dear, my precious one` humour; Tanflora/Trade Centre/Bio-Technology projects; industrial-gases/Saint-Gobain/Pennar/Vasavi/Kanjamalai/textile figures; the anomalous printed 24-3-2001 date; the Rasipuram/Ariyalur anti-privatisation argument and socialist repetition; printed Counter Affidavit English and Tamil gloss; cement-production figures; public/private wage comparison; Ambuja Rs.85/Rs.145; 50 per cent/tender modernisation argument; and the p.302 lead-in to the 111 cut-motion joke. English remains unverified until final source p.303 passes Gate G.
